ANSWER: NO

HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects the key financial terms present in the source document. The only specific financial covenant mentioned in the memo - the $15,000,000 limit on early termination fees in any four-quarter fiscal period (excluding Applegreen Purchase Agreement lease termination fees) - is directly supported by Section 2.2 of the source document. 

The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for deal terms not specified in the amendment document (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency), which is accurate since this is an amendment document that doesn't restate the full original credit agreement terms. All party names, dates (February 20, 2024 for the amendment, January 26, 2024 for the Applegreen Purchase Agreement), and transaction structure details are accurately reflected from the source document.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS: 
- First Amendment Effective Date (defined as the date when all conditions in Section 3 are satisfied/waived)
- Specific lender composition and roles (Citizens Bank as both Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent, M&T Bank as L/C Issuer)
- Material condition precedent that initial closing under Applegreen Purchase Agreement must occur simultaneously with or before the amendment
- Borrower obligation to pay Administrative Agent's legal fees and disbursements as condition to effectiveness
- PATRIOT Act compliance documentation requirements as effectiveness condition
- Collateral continuation provisions confirming existing liens secure all obligations under amended agreement
